scope: author-reported source metadata and reading depth only, not independent scientific replication

studies.study_type: E coli microfluidic growth/induction plus theoretical model
studies.units: five chambers per plotted condition, shared population
studies.outcome: ~35m lag/55m recovery glucose->lactose; minutes-to-generations memory; theoretical up to 100% increase lactose consumption
studies.caveat: double flux is model prediction, not measured doubled growth; enzymes preexist

studies.study_type: barcoded yeast pooled fitness across fluctuating/static environments
studies.units: 1–2 independent evolution flasks per environment, 889 selected mutant clones, three assay replicates
studies.outcome: 53% component-memory cases significant, 29% component static-fitness-predictor reversal, 30% nonadditivity cases significant
studies.caveat: 889 clones are not 889 independent evolution populations; lag-time mechanism theoretical/association

studies.study_type: B subtilis memory information across ten initial histories
studies.units: three replicate cultures per ten histories, shared reporter genotypes
studies.outcome: ~1.96 bits transient sporulation, ~0.8813 bits finite 21–24h late response; information limit set by experimental histories
studies.caveat: information about past not demonstrated survival benefit

studies.study_type: control theory based on historical chemotaxis experiments
studies.units: analytical model, not a new cell evolution cohort
studies.outcome: methylation-linked integral feedback supports perfect adaptation within assumptions
studies.caveat: fixed biological apparatus can mimic learning, not an evolved digital controller

studies.outcome: fast stochastic switchers gain under frequent change, slow switchers under rare changes
studies.caveat: researcher designed switching dynamics and favorable phenotypes
